method: Designated 2018 low-income-community tracts vs eligible tracts not designated, 50 states and DC. Each 2016-2024 change is compared with what controls in the same state with the same 2016 level and 2011-16 trend saw; residuals are scaled by the controls' spread and signed toward more money. Descriptive: selection was not random, and tract data cannot separate residents gaining from newcomers arriving.

outcomes.label: Homes lived in by their owners
